features.title: Everything you need to launch.
features.description: The Next.js 16 starter for AI SaaS. Authentication, billing, AI components, i18n and a dashboard, already wired together.

cta.title: Start building today.
cta.description: Clone the repository and run a production-ready SaaS locally in minutes.

ai.title: Streaming AI chat, ready to go.
ai.description: 40+ components for chat, reasoning and tool calls, built on the Vercel AI SDK.
ai.prompt: Which plan drove signups last week?
ai.answer: Professional brought in 58% of new signups, up 24% on the week before. Most of the growth came from annual billing.

trim.title: Keep only what you need.
trim.description: One command removes a feature with its code, dependencies, env vars, translations and docs.

auth.title: Sign-in, handled.
auth.description: Email and password, GitHub and Google, with sessions and JWT from Better Auth.

payments.title: Get paid from day one.
payments.description: Subscriptions, annual plans, free trials and one-time purchases, synced by webhooks.

dashboard.title: Every user gets a dashboard.
dashboard.description: Profile and usage pages on PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM. One command starts the database.

theming.title: Light by day. Dark by night.
theming.description: shadcn/ui on Tailwind CSS 4 follows the system theme, with no flash on load. Try it here.

i18n.title: Every language, one codebase.
i18n.description: Switch the URL strategy with one line. Canonical URLs, hreflang tags and the sitemap follow.

notes.never: One URL, language from the NEXT_LOCALE cookie

stack.title: Built on the modern web.
stack.description: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4, with the libraries you would pick already set up.
